facts: Archived NIOSH table (Potassium hydroxide, solution <70%) places Butyl; Natural; Nitrile; PVC; and Viton in the 8-hour protective-clothing group.
Archived NIOSH table (Potassium hydroxide, solution <70%) places Teflon and PE/EVAL in the 4-hour protective-clothing group.
payload.query: For potassium hydroxide solution below 70 percent, which barriers does the archived NIOSH table place in its 8-hour group and which in its 4-hour group?
payload.answer:
Evidence-grounded answer:

- Archived NIOSH table (Potassium hydroxide, solution <70%) places Butyl; Natural; Nitrile; PVC; and Viton in the 8-hour protective-clothing group. [NIOSH Recommendations for Chemical Protective ...: https://archive.cdc.gov/www_cdc_gov/niosh/ncpc/azncpc.html]
- Archived NIOSH table (Potassium hydroxide, solution <70%) places Teflon and PE/EVAL in the 4-hour protective-clothing group. [NIOSH Recommendations for Chemical Protective ...: https://archive.cdc.gov/www_cdc_gov/niosh/ncpc/azncpc.html]
